items.titulo: Meet Thinking Machines Inkling 2 Mini: 26B Looped MoE Runs on a 32GB Mac
items.resumen: Thinking Machines released Inkling 2 Mini, a 26.4B-parameter looped MoE transformer with 3.4B active parameters. It runs on a 32GB Mac or one DGX Spark and scores 79.2% on SWE-bench Verified. The post Meet Thinking Machines Inkling 2 Mini: 26B Looped MoE Runs on a 32GB Mac appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items.titulo: OpenAI Ships GPT-Live-1.1 for Voice Agents, Cuts Idle Cost to $0.02/Min
items.resumen: OpenAI has released GPT-Live-1.1 in the API. The full-duplex voice model improves multilingual accents and transcription, and a new standby mode bills idle WebRTC time at $0.02 per minute instead of $0.05. The post OpenAI Ships GPT-Live-1.1 for Voice Agents, Cuts Idle Cost to $0.02/Min appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items.titulo: Baseten Releases Bison-1 and Groundhog-1, Topping Decision Model Index
items.resumen: Baseten released bison-1 and groundhog-1, open-weight decision models built on Gemma 4. bison-1 scores 76 on the AA Decision Index v2.1, and both models support 128k context and image input.
